# Ecologics Cleaning

> Eco-friendly carpet and upholstery steam cleaning company based in Bromsgrove, serving Birmingham, Solihull, Wolverhampton, Walsall and the wider West Midlands, Worcestershire and Warwickshire. Non-toxic, pet-safe products, fully insured, free no-obligation quotes.

Business details: Ecologics Cleaning Solutions Ltd. Phone 0800 274 0077. Email info@ecologicscleaning.co.uk. Website https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk

## Services
- [Carpet cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/carpet-cleaning.html): hot-water extraction steam cleaning
- [Upholstery & sofa cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/upholstery-cleaning.html): fabric-safe low-moisture steam cleaning
- [Rug cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/rug-cleaning.html): wool, silk, cotton and synthetic rugs
- [Stain removal](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/stain-removal.html): wine, coffee, grease, ink and pet stains and odours
- [Curtain & mattress cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/curtain-mattress-cleaning.html)
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/end-of-tenancy.html)
- [Deep cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/deep-cleaning.html)
- [Commercial cleaning](https://ecologicscleaning.co.uk/services/commercial-cleaning.html)
